verdict.rationale: Circle is a regulated stablecoin and payments provider, so the question of which licensed or registered entities stand behind it and which jurisdictions they cover applies. Nothing in the pack names those entities, their licenses or registrations, or their jurisdictional coverage. The closest items are a mention that Circle 'handles licensing' in its Managed CPN model and an API endpoint listing supported countries. Neither identifies who the founder is actually contracting with.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see who I'm actually contracting with — the licensed or registered entities behind the product and the jurisdictions they cover, published rather than buried
